# destination a home and the mesh learned is the same one after a power

# application partition covers all of the 16 MiB flash up to 0xFB0000
# store needs an entry of its own here; the firmware finds both by label
# (`src/flash.rs`) and runs without persistence on a board flashed with any
# nvs and phy_init stay where the default table puts them (nothing here
# reads either). The application gets 8 MiB: the image is 1.3 MB today and
# carries its map regions in place
